items.title: Joseph "Fan" Bourgeau Interview, 1959-09-24
items.q: So now and then we'd say, well, see Fate, he'd play high society for us.

ctx.x: I don't know. Where is he at? So when Tab and them would come and play for us, well we'd all, you know, let them play. Instead of us playing. You see what I mean? He was on the boat then. He was on the boat playing with Fate and Marvel. And I had Bunnell playing piano with me. You see what I mean? So now and then we'd say, well, see Fate, he'd play high society for us. And Fate would play, you know, he's high society like he'd play. So when he'd get through playing I'd say, all right Bunnell. You know what I…
No, but I've heard about Lester told us a little bit.
